specifications.name: Walls must have a name
specifications.description: Checks whether every applicable IfcWall provides its IFC Name attribute.

specifications.name: Walls must declare IsExternal
specifications.description: Checks the presence and IFC data type of Pset_WallCommon.IsExternal.

metadata.@instructions: Declare whether the wall is external.

requirements.label: Pset_WallCommon.IsExternal
requirements.description: IsExternal data shall be provided in the dataset Pset_WallCommon

specifications.name: Beams must declare LoadBearing
specifications.description: Checks the presence and IFC data type of Pset_BeamCommon.LoadBearing.

metadata.@instructions: Declare whether the beam is load-bearing.

requirements.label: Pset_BeamCommon.LoadBearing
requirements.description: LoadBearing data shall be provided in the dataset Pset_BeamCommon

specifications.name: Duct segments need spatial assignment
specifications.description: Checks whether each IfcDuctSegment is directly contained in an IfcSpace or IfcBuildingStorey.

metadata.@instructions: Assign the HVAC element directly to an IfcSpace or IfcBuildingStorey.

requirements.label: IFCRELCONTAINEDINSPATIALSTRUCTURE
requirements.description: An element must have an IFCRELCONTAINEDINSPATIALSTRUCTURE relationship with an {'enumeration': ['IFCSPACE', 'IFCBUILDINGSTOREY']}

specifications.name: Air terminals need spatial assignment
specifications.description: Checks whether each IfcAirTerminal is directly contained in an IfcSpace or IfcBuildingStorey.

metadata.@instructions: Assign the HVAC element directly to an IfcSpace or IfcBuildingStorey.

requirements.label: IFCRELCONTAINEDINSPATIALSTRUCTURE
requirements.description: An element must have an IFCRELCONTAINEDINSPATIALSTRUCTURE relationship with an {'enumeration': ['IFCSPACE', 'IFCBUILDINGSTOREY']}

specifications.name: Duct segments need assumed EPC metadata
specifications.description: Project-specific assumed EPC delivery requirement for IfcDuctSegment elements.

metadata.@instructions: Provide the project-assumed EPC asset tag.

requirements.label: EPC_Delivery.AssetTag
requirements.description: AssetTag data shall be provided in the dataset EPC_Delivery

metadata.@instructions: Provide the project-assumed EPC system code.

requirements.label: EPC_Delivery.SystemCode
requirements.description: SystemCode data shall be provided in the dataset EPC_Delivery

specifications.name: Air terminals need assumed EPC metadata
specifications.description: Project-specific assumed EPC delivery requirement for IfcAirTerminal elements.

metadata.@instructions: Provide the project-assumed EPC asset tag.

requirements.label: EPC_Delivery.AssetTag
requirements.description: AssetTag data shall be provided in the dataset EPC_Delivery

metadata.@instructions: Provide the project-assumed EPC system code.

requirements.label: EPC_Delivery.SystemCode
requirements.description: SystemCode data shall be provided in the dataset EPC_Delivery

specifications.name: Walls must declare their material
specifications.description: Checks whether every applicable IfcWall is associated with a material, layer set, or constituent set.

metadata.@instructions: Associate the wall with a material, material layer set, or constituent set.

specifications.name: Columns must declare a meaningful predefined type
specifications.description: Checks whether every applicable IfcColumn declares a predefined type other than NOTDEFINED or USERDEFINED.

metadata.@instructions: Declare COLUMN or PILASTER. NOTDEFINED states nothing.

requirements.label: IFC Class / Predefined Type
requirements.description: Shall be IFCCOLUMN data of type {'enumeration': ['COLUMN', 'PILASTER']}

specifications.name: Beams must declare a meaningful predefined type
specifications.description: Checks whether every applicable IfcBeam declares a predefined type other than NOTDEFINED or USERDEFINED.

metadata.@instructions: Declare the beam's type. A name string is not a predefined type.

requirements.label: IFC Class / Predefined Type
requirements.description: Shall be IFCBEAM data of type {'enumeration': ['BEAM', 'JOIST', 'HOLLOWCORE', 'LINTEL', 'SPANDREL', 'T_BEAM']}

specifications.name: Walls must carry an element-level classification reference
specifications.description: Project-specific assumed EPC delivery requirement: classification recorded on the element, not only on the building.

metadata.@instructions: Classify the wall itself, not only the building that contains it.

requirements.label: System / Reference
requirements.description: Shall have a CCI Construction reference of {'pattern': '[A-Z]-[A-Z]{3}'}
